slides.title: Participle clauses
slides.subtitle: Making writing more concise
goals: Use **-ing** clauses for active, simultaneous or cause.

slides.title: Types

head: Type
Example
Meaning
rows: **Built** in 1850, the house is very old.
**While walking** home, I saw an accident.

slides.watch: The subject must be the same in both clauses. *Walking home, the rain started* ✗ (the rain wasn't walking!).

items.q: ___ the email, she called her boss.
___ in 1910, the theater is a national monument.
Not ___ what to say, I stayed quiet.
